finalists.label: Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis
finalists.why: The candidate has the most specific and decisive findings, including cavitary and noncavitary nodules and masses with faint surrounding ground-glass opacity and yeast-like structures associated with septate hyphae demonstrating acute-angle branching.

finalists.label: Pulmonary Fungal Infection
finalists.why: The candidate has a broad range of findings, including multiple nodules and masses of various sizes in both lung fields, some with cavitation, and diffuse necrotizing granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements.

finalists.label: Blastomycosis
finalists.why: The candidate has some specific findings, including multiple nodules and masses of various sizes in both lung fields, some with cavitation, and diffuse necrotizing granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements, but is less specific than Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive findings, including yeast-like structures associated with septate hyphae demonstrating acute-angle branching, which is a distinctive feature of Aspergillosis.
